observation.command:
# Find required env vars for these 3 services
cd /workspace/02-backend && echo "== kommentar required:"; grep -rhoE "os\.environ\[['\"]\w+['\"]\]|Field\(|os\.getenv\(['\"]\w+['\"]\)" kommentar-service/src/ 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "\w+['\"]?\)?" | tr -d "['\"])" | sort -u | head
echo "== bmds-api settings:"; grep -rhoE "^\s*\w+\s*:\s*\w+" 02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/api/demospipes_addon_bmds_api/ 2>/dev/null | head
# Provide a broad set of the documented common env vars
echo "== kommentar with full config:"
docker run --rm -e SERVICE_NAME=kommentar -e SERVICE_VERSION=1.0 -e RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://localhost -e POSTGRES_URL=postgres://localhost --entrypoint sh kommentar-service -c 'cd /app && .venv/bin/python -c "import src.main; print(\"KOMMENTAR IMPORT OK\")"' 2>&1 | tail -3
